title: Recognition of the state of Manchukuo, anticipated disturbances

SHANGHAI TIMES

Official diplomatic recognition has
been extended to Manchoukuo by
the Bulgarian Government, it is
officially announced in Sofia. The
recognition was formally extended
in a note handed by the Bulgarian
Foreign Minister, Mr. Ivan Popoff,
to Mr. Kozo Izumi, Acting Japanese
Minister.

《上海泰晤士报》

据索非亚官方宣布，保加利亚政府已给予满洲国外交承认。保加利亚外交部长伊万·波波夫（Ivan Popoff）先生向日本代办泉幸三（Kozo Izumi）先生递交照会，正式予以承认。

page_data.en:
Political State Criminals
Will Get Liberation

HSINKING, Jan. 20.--(Rengo)--
Some 4,000 criminals and political
offenders in Manchukuo will be
granted a special amnesty on the
occasion of the coronation of the
Chief Executive of Manchukuo,
Mr. Henry Pu Yi, as Emperor, on
March 1, and will have their terms
reduced, it is authoritatively lear-
ned here.
page_data.zh:
政治犯将获释放

新京，1月20日.--（联合通讯社）-- 据悉，值此满洲国执政溥仪先生于3月1日登基称帝之际，满洲国将对约4,000名罪犯和政治犯实行特赦，并减短其刑期。

一旦出现骚乱迹象，应立即采取以下步骤：

(1) 取消受影响区域的徒步巡更，改为不少于4人的巡逻队。

(2) 最大限度利用机动巡逻队。

(3) 在配有机动车的警署保留预备队。
